{{Quote|So what can I help you with?''"''<br />''"''I ask you to write the truth about my people.|Tem Eliss and S'itl Thirr|<ref name="SWAJ14" />}}
'''S'itl Thirr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Abinyshi]], short, thin, and [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] like other members of his [[Species/Legends|species]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Thirr visited the office of the [[Iyra]] [[sentientologist]] [[Tem Eliss]] in the [[University of Sanbra]]'s [[Sentient Studies Department]] in an effort to dispel misinformation that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had spread about the supposed extinction of the Abinyshi [[Species/Legends|species]]. There, the [[Professor/Legends|professor]] was working on a publication known as ''[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life]]''. After Thirr granted an interview to the Iyra and explained his species' true predicament,<ref name="SWAJ14">{{JournalCite|14|An Extinct Guest}}</ref> the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] added an entry on the Abinyshi to his ''Guide'' that told Thirr's version of the species' story.<ref name="SWAJ14 AE">{{JournalCite|14|Alien Encounters (article series)}}</ref>
